tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mchog gsang lam khrid chen mo bzhugs so/ /

ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thig le gsang ba yi ge med pa las/ khrid kyi rim pa ngo sprod zab mo'i gnad/ /gcig tu bsdus te phyi rabs don du bri/ /de la gsum las/ sngon 'gro nyams su blang pa la bdun gyi dang po bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ snang srid kun tu bzang po'i zhing du gsal ba'i ngang las/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyi bor bsams la gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal ni gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bkod la sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang lha mi'i longs spyod du bsams la dbul lo/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thug kar yi ge brgya pa bsam la bzlas so/ /bzhi pa tshe mi rtag pa'i lam khyer ni/ phyi dus bzhi 'gyur ba/ nang phung po 'gyur ba/ gsang ba bar do yin pa'i 'du shes bsgom mo/ /lnga pa 'khor ba'i skyo shas ni/ 'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal la bsam mo/ /drug pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can la phar rang gi bde ba byin pa dang*/ de dag gi sdug bsngal tshur rang la blang ba gnyis spel mar bsgom/ snying rje chen po bsgom pa'o/ /bdun pa gzung 'dzin sems kyi rtsa ba gcad pa la gsum las/ dang po phyi gzung ba'i yul lngar rang bzhin med par sbyar ba ni/ 'di ltar yul lngar snang ba'i chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar med bzhin snang ba yang*/ snang ba'i dus 'di nyid nas rten med pa/ gnas med pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo/ /nang 'dzin pa sems kyi rtsa ba gcad pa la/ dgag sgrub rtog tshogs su shar ba'i sems 'di nyid/ dang po byung sa dang*/ byung mkhan dang*/ bar du gnas sa dang*/ gnas mkhan dang*/ tha mar 'gro sa dang 'gro mkhan/ dbyibs kha dog /ngo bo ngos gzung brtags pas sems nyid nam mkha' ltar rtogs pa ni/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa'o/

/sngon 'gro de dag shin tu 'byongs pa gces so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ngo sprad pa la gnyis las/ ka dag chos sku ru ngo sprad pas da lta nyams su blang ba ni/ tshogs gtor bshams/ gsol ba btab/ lus gnad bcas/ brgyud pa'i bshar btab nas/ brda sbyar ba ni/ da ltar gyi rang rig zang thal rjen pa'i ngo bo 'di la ltos dang*/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa med pa/ stong pa la bdag med pa/ rig pa ngos bzung med pa 'di chos sku yin pas/ 'di'i ngang la ma yengs bcos bslad med par rang sor skyongs shig /ces thebs par gdab bo/ /lhun grub 'od gsal du ngo sprad pas bar dor grol bar byed pa la/ mthongs kha nyi zhur la shel gyis mtshon te/ ye thog gzhi'i gnas lugs/ kun tu bzang po'i grol lugs/ ma rig sems can kyi 'khrul lugs/ sems dang ye shes kyi gnas lugs/ gdams pa nyams len gyi byed lugs/ bar do 'od gsal gyi grol lugs rnams ngo sprad rting*/ skar khung bkag la/ mi mo la brten nas zhugs gnas don gsum gyi ngo sprod dam/ brda bskor sa la bkod pa/ de shel gyi bteg la dpe don rtags gsum gyis ngo sprad nas sku gsum ngo sprad pa'ang shel dang nyi ma/ 'dra 'bag gsum la brten nas/ shel chos sku/ 'dra 'bag longs sku/ nyi ma las zer 'phros pa sprul sku'i ngo sprod rnams lag len brgyud pa bzhin ngo sprad nas/ nyi zhur la shel 'phyar ba'i zhur gyis snying nas mig tu 'brel pa'i rtsa lam ngo sprad pa dang*/ sems dang yeshes rgyab gyes pa'i dus ngo sprad pa dang*/ bar do'i gzhi snang ngo sprad pa dang*/ sgra 'od zer gsum gyi 'char tshul ngo sprad pa dang*/ lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs su sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pas nang gsal chos skur bzhugs bzhin du/ phyi gsal longs sprul gyis gzhan don mdzad pa dang bcas pa rnams gzabs la ngo sprad do/ /'di rnams snyan brgyud gsum ka rdzogs pa'i lam khrid chen mo yin no/

/gsum pa rjes rgyab chos ni/ rgyas bsdus ci rigs bshad nas bka' rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar snyan brgyud yi ge med pa yi/ /lam khrid chen po bkod pa'i bsod nams des/ /ma lus 'gro kun theg mchog 'dir zhugs te/ /rgyal mchog kun tu bzang po'i gnas thob shog /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud mchog tu gsang ba'i lam khrid chen mo zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)mchog gsang lam khrid chen mo/ -PAGE 14--PAGE 15--PAGE 13-
